answer: At 4 units per epoch, sustaining 316 aliases for 56 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. The fee is charged through an ivory debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the zephyr totals, and the echo anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee repeats 21 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
